typography.hierarchy: Apple minimalist approach. H1: 32px, H2: 24px, Body: 16px, Caption: 12px.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows on floating elements, 0px 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #C6C6C8 for separators, avoiding transparent backgrounds on overlays
visual_enhancers.corner_radius: 12px for standard cards, 8px for smaller inputs

component_name.LanguageToggle: Segmented Control or high-contrast Saffron Pill Toggle

grids.base: Mobile-first, 1-column flow, generous vertical spacing (16px to 24px between blocks)

layouts.padding: Generous edge padding (16px - 24px). Touch targets must be minimum 44x44pt for 320-430pt screen reliability.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned content for readability, centered bottom-anchored CTA buttons.

motion.transitions: React Native default LayoutAnimation or Reanimated smooth springs for toggle switches.

accessibility.touch_targets: MINIMUM 44x44 points for all interactive elements.
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='language-toggle-btn', data-testid='date-picker-input').

media.images: High-quality, minimal distractions. 80vh max height on mobile constraints.

3d_libraries.usage: Not applicable for this standard mobile application fix.

instructions_to_main_agent: APP-WIDE LANGUAGE CONTEXT: Implement a React Context (`LanguageContext.js`) at the root of the app (`App.js`). The state must be set on the first screen and consumed by every subsequent screen to switch between Tamil and English.
CORRECTION MODE EXCEPTION: Do not apply the `LanguageContext` strings to Correction Mode. Keep its existing functionality completely intact without localizing it.

NATIVE DATE/TIME PICKER: Replace the buggy 'old UI' date/time selector. Install/Use `@react-native-community/datetimepicker` (or standard Expo native pickers) to summon the native iOS/Android bottom-sheet/wheel interfaces. Ensure it triggers flawlessly on click.
UI PRESERVATION: Maintain the 'Apple-minimalist saffron UI'. Use the Saffron brand color (#FF9933) for primary actions and toggles. Ensure stark white/black contrasts.
TOUCH RELIABILITY: Ensure the date/time trigger inputs and the language toggle have a minimum touch area of 44x44pt.
TESTING: Add `data-testid` to the new Date picker trigger, the Time picker trigger, and the Language Toggle buttons.
NO TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS: Ensure modals, headers, and pickers have a solid background (e.g., white or Saffron) to prevent overlap issues.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Ensure the saffron Apple-minimalist design feels premium, not like a cheap template. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure native UI paradigms (like native date pickers) are properly integrated without visual glitches. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Every interaction needs micro-feedback (opacity changes on press). Do NOT apply generic transparent backgrounds to overlays; use frosted glass or solid surfaces.
